For mise installations of Node.js. The mirror must provide archives and SHASUMS256.txt.
用于 npm 和 pnpm 软件包下载，独立于 Node.js 本体的下载源。: For packages downloaded by npm and pnpm. Node.js itself uses a separate source.
适用于现代 Yarn。Yarn Classic 可使用 npm / pnpm 软: For modern Yarn. Yarn Classic can use the npm / pnpm registry.
用于 bun install，通过生成的工作区 Bun 配置使用。: Use the generated workspace Bun configuration with bun install.
适用于 nvm-sh。mise 安装 Node.js 时请选择 Node.js: For nvm-sh. Choose the Node.js download mirror when installing Node.js with mise.
用于 mise 下载 Go 本体，镜像需提供安装包及对应的 SHA-256 文件: For mise downloads of Go. The mirror must provide archives and their SHA-256 files.
用于 Go 模块依赖下载，保留 direct 回退。: Downloads Go module dependencies and keeps the direct fallback.
用于 pip 安装依赖，独立于 Python 本体的下载源。: For dependencies installed with pip. Python itself uses a separate source.
用于 uv 安装 Python 软件包。: For Python packages installed with uv.
用于 uv python install，不改变 mise 的 Python 下: For uv python install. Python installations managed by mise use a separate source.
Poetry 镜像属于具体项目。生成使用说明，可在所需项目中应用。: Poetry sources are configured per project. Generate instructions to apply the mirror in the project you choose.
成对设置 Rustup 工具链地址和更新地址。: Sets the Rustup toolchain and update URLs together.
用于 Cargo 依赖下载。选回官方源会移除工具箱生成的替代源。: For Cargo dependencies. Choosing the official source removes the replacement generated by Mise Toolbox.
用于 Flutter 下载组件和构建产物。: For Flutter components and build artifacts.
生成 Maven 设置文件和 Gradle 初始化脚本，独立于 JDK 下载。: Generates Maven settings and a Gradle init script. JDK downloads use a separate source.
生成供 dotnet restore 使用的配置文件，独立于 .NET SDK: Generates a configuration file for dotnet restore. .NET SDK downloads use a separate source.
